extraction.Name: Louise Beauvais Young
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes, I protested to the postmaster, Mr. Weston, but he said it had been sent to me and I had to take it.
extraction.Buyer: Ella McHenry, through Clement Valandra. Records also show sold to J. C. Snyder and Anna Hughes, but allottee states she knows nothing about that and only signed papers once, to McHenry.
extraction.NOTES: Was to receive $1800 for land but only received $500 in cash; remaining consideration was in the form of a barn, some horses, a note for some clothing and other articles in the city of Winner — horses were mortgaged so she did not get them, same applies to the barn; wrote regarding the note and received reply that the person would come to see her but she never came. Has thirteen living children, nine at home. Not satisfied with sale because she did not receive what she was supposed to receive. Patent received in post office at St. Francis, South Dakota; does not remember the date.
